segments.text: This model predicts Bangalore flat prices with 99 percent accuracy.
segments.caption: This model predicts Bangalore flat prices with 99% accuracy.

segments.text: And it's completely useless. Can you spot why?
segments.caption: And it's completely useless. Can you spot why?

segments.text: One of its inputs was the stamp duty paid. Stamp duty is calculated from the sale price. So the model was secretly reading the answer.
segments.caption: One of its inputs was the stamp duty paid. Stamp duty is calculated from the sale price. So the model was secretly reading the answer.

segments.text: Before the flat is sold, that number doesn't even exist.

segments.text: Day six of 100 Days of Machine Learning: features, labels, and the six tests every good feature must pass.
segments.caption: Day 6 of 100 Days of Machine Learning: features, labels, and the 6 tests every good feature must pass.

segments.text: First, the words. The label, also called the target, is what you want to predict: the price.
segments.caption: First, the words. The label, also called the target, is what you want to predict: the price.

segments.text: Features are the inputs the model uses to predict it: area, bedrooms, locality, age.
segments.caption: Features are the inputs the model uses to predict it: area, bedrooms, locality, age.

segments.text: And check the label too. Asking price or sold price? Predict the wrong one and everything after is wrong.
segments.caption: And check the label too. Asking price or sold price? Predict the wrong one and everything after is wrong.

segments.text: Test one: will you know it at prediction time?
segments.caption: Test 1: will you know it at prediction time?

segments.text: Stamp duty, days on market, final negotiated discount: all known only after the sale. Using them is data leakage.
segments.caption: Stamp duty, days on market, final negotiated discount: all known only after the sale. Using them is data leakage.

segments.text: Rule: if you won't have it when you predict, it can't be a feature.
segments.caption: Rule: if you won't have it when you predict, it can't be a feature.

segments.text: Test two: is it actually related to the label?
segments.caption: Test 2: is it actually related to the label?

segments.text: Listing ID number, or the broker's phone number. With enough rows, the model finds fake patterns in pure noise.
segments.caption: Listing ID number, or the broker's phone number. With enough rows, the model finds fake patterns in pure noise.

segments.text: Rule: there should be a real reason it affects the price.
segments.caption: Rule: there should be a real reason it affects the price.

segments.text: Test three: is it a duplicate?
segments.caption: Test 3: is it a duplicate?

segments.text: Area in square feet and area in square metres are the same information twice. The model gets confused about which one matters.
segments.caption: Area in square feet and area in square metres are the same information twice. The model gets confused about which one matters.

segments.text: Rule: keep one version of each piece of information.
segments.caption: Rule: keep one version of each piece of information.

segments.text: Test four: is it filled in enough?
segments.caption: Test 4: is it filled in enough?

segments.text: Parking type is blank for seventy percent of flats. Filling in that much would be mostly guessing.
segments.caption: Parking type is blank for 70% of flats. Filling in that much would be mostly guessing.

segments.text: Rule: drop it, or keep just a has parking info flag.
segments.caption: Rule: drop it, or keep just a has parking info flag.

segments.text: Test five: does it actually vary?
segments.caption: Test 5: does it actually vary?

segments.text: City equals Bangalore, in every single row. A column that never changes can't explain anything.
segments.caption: City equals Bangalore, in every single row. A column that never changes can't explain anything.

segments.text: Rule: remove constant and almost constant columns.
segments.caption: Rule: remove constant and almost constant columns.

segments.text: Test six: is it fair and legal?
segments.caption: Test 6: is it fair and legal?

segments.text: Never use things like the owner's religion or caste, even if they seem to correlate. And watch for proxies that sneak them back in.
segments.caption: Never use things like the owner's religion or caste, even if they seem to correlate. And watch for proxies that sneak them back in.

segments.text: Rule: if you couldn't defend it in public, don't use it.
segments.caption: Rule: if you couldn't defend it in public, don't use it.

segments.text: And remember, the best features are often built, not found. Build year becomes age. An address becomes distance to the nearest metro.
segments.caption: And remember, the best features are often built, not found. Build year becomes age. An address becomes distance to the nearest metro.

segments.text: So, the six tests: available in time, related, not duplicate, filled in, varies, and fair.
segments.caption: So, the 6 tests: available in time, related, not duplicate, filled in, varies, and fair.
